title: BiasConnect: Investigating Bias Interactions in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images with counterfactual gender prompts (e.g., male vs. female) and extracting perceived gender attributes using a Visual Question Answering (VQA) model to analyze intersectional dependencies.
Evaluating text-to-image models by generating images with counterfactual age prompts (e.g., young, middle-aged, old) and using VQA to extract the perceived age group.
Generating images using counterfactual prompts for various ethnicities (e.g., white, african american, asian) and using a VQA model to detect the perceived race to quantify causal bias interactions.
Assessed by generating images with counterfactual prompts related to physique (obese, slim, muscular) and extracting the depicted body type using VQA.
Evaluated by prompting for specific disabilities (e.g., blind, hearing aid, wheelchair) versus 'fit' and extracting the presence of these traits via VQA.
Assessed by generating images using counterfactual prompts for attire (formal vs. informal) and using VQA to classify the clothing style to observe its correlation with other biases.
Measured by generating images with prompts for specific emotions (happy, sad, serious, tired) and extracting the depicted emotion using VQA.
Evaluated by prompting for indoor versus outdoor working environments and using VQA to classify the physical setting of the generated image.
Evaluated using the TIBET dataset's creative prompts to measure how specific geographic regions in prompts causally affect other visual elements like ethnicity.
Evaluated using the TIBET dataset to analyze interactions between varying aesthetics or cultural traditions and the depicted religious identities in generated images.
